risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions cybersecurity threats and incidents as a significant risk to its systems, networks, products and services. A dedicated Chief Information Security Officer and regular Board reporting indicate the materiality of this risk.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company operates across multiple jurisdictions with varying regulatory and industry standards, although with no mention of significant incidents or non-compliance

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive markets (packaging, electronics, medical, appliances, energy, transportation) with constant need to maintain competitive positioning

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: The company generates 67% of revenue outside the United States and operates manufacturing facilities in 10 countries, exposing it to geopolitical and foreign exchange risks

risks.title: Key Person
risks.score_rationale: Sundaram Nagarajan leads the company, but a distributed organizational structure (Owner Mindset) and an experienced management team reduce dependency on any single individual

ai_positioning.summary: Nordson does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its fiscal 2025 10-K/20-F report. The Ascend strategy focuses on NBS Next (data-driven segmentation framework), Owner Mindset, and winning teams, with no explicit reference to AI.
